faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for Indbank Project Executive / Senior Project Executive - Accounts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Indbank Merchant Banking Services Limited (Indbank) for filling positions in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under Indbank Adv/2026/08 notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Project Executive / Senior Project Executive - Accounts post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Indbank Project Executive Accounts post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Chartered Accountant with a minimum of 2 years of experience or CA inter qualified, appearing for Final with 2 or 3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Indbank Project Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 25 and 45 years as per the cutoff date specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Indbank Project Executive Accounts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a competitive compensation package ranging from Rs. 8 to Rs. 12 lakh p.a. CTC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of duly filled offline application forms is 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for Indbank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must download the application form and send it via courier/registered post or email.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent to Head Administration, No 480, 1st Floor Khivraj Complex I, Anna Salai, Nandanam, Chennai-35 or emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Indbank Project Executive post?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises screening of applications by a screening committee followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form directly from the official website at www.indbankonline.com.
